# 21.B.85 Applicable environmental protection requirements
# id: 21.B.85
# source: external/Part-21_EAR_Reg-748-2012_Nov-2025.pdf
# chars: 500

21.B.85 Applicable environmental protection requirements for a 
type certificate or restricted type certificate 
Regulation (EU) 2025/1065 
(a) 
For a type certificate or restricted type certificate for an aircraft or for a type certificate for an 
engine, the Agency shall designate and notify to the applicant the applicable environmental 
protection requirements from the essential requirements referred to in the first subparagraph 
of Article 9(2) of Regulation (EU) 2018/1139. 
(b) 
(reserved).
